title: Recital: Al-Muddaththir: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Qiyamah, hamzat al-wasl and alif-lam
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 33 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Recital rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 33. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ (١) قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ (٢) وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ (٣) وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ (٤) وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ (٥) وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ (٦) وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ (٧) فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ (٨) فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ (٩) عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ (١٠)

كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ (٣٨) إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ (٣٩) فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ (٤٠) عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ (٤١) مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ (٤٢) قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ (٤٣) وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ (٤٤) وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ (٤٥) وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ (٤٦) حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ (٤٧) فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ (٤٨)

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil recites one ayah of Al-Muddaththir 74:1-56 in register order.
questions.a: 74:1-56 recited in order by the class.

questions.q: Recital rota: today's group recites Al-Muddaththir 74:1-56 to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link the weakest section and log revision.
questions.a: Rubric marked with one target for each pupil.

questions.q: Extend: write your target in the portal response box. Start: 'In my next recital I will ...'
questions.a: For example: 'In my next recital I will make the saktah in 75:27 without a breath.'

questions.q: Recite Al-Muddaththir 74:47 in your head. How does the next ayah begin?
Think again: Al-Muddaththir begins with the command 'Arise and warn' (74:2). What does it ask of a believer today?
questions.a: To stand up for the truth, keep clean, glorify Allah and be patient (74:2 to 7).
